test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

In exactly the same words as were used originally
solution:
The correct answer is **Verbatim.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct answer for the given group of words is Verbatim.
 
• Verbatim meaning is precisely the exact words as were used initially.
 
• Thus the correct answer is Verbatim.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Imprecise means a lack of precision and accuracy in expression or detail.
 
• Strict means requiring that behavioural guidelines be followed and obeyed.
 
• Neutral means not assisting or backing either party in a fight, argument, etc.
